content:
alexcrichton opened PR #14953 from alexcrichton:adjust-return-code to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit fixes a minor issue where if a guest cancelled a stream read/write bottoming out in a host stream, and the host stream completed with some items, then the return code was COMPLETED instead of CANCELLED. This is only possible to surface right now in guest-to-host streams, not guest-to-guest streams.
